label: caiso 30 ct baseline
definition: CAISO 30: add the year-round local-RA BASELINE to the CT_PEAKER reliability floor (caiso_ct_floor_base=0.049 = measured median CAMPD CT_PEAKER evening (15-22) capacity factor on cool days TMAX<25C, 2023-2025 — the regression intercept the temperature hot-limb fit clips to zero). frac = clip(base + slope*(TMAX-T0), base, cap). Lifts CT_PEAKER toward its measured local-RA level and trims CC_REGULAR with no price-level change. Strict improvement over caiso-29; CT_CHP EOR over-dispatch remains the open C1 blocker (gas-floor/CHP coupling, documented in docs/caiso-ct-reliability-floor-2026-06.md).
